headline: Across media, gaming, publishing and education firms are balancing growth with cost cuts and selective tech investment.
summary: Media companies posted solid revenue growth but are tightening spend to hit multi‑billion savings targets. Gaming operators see mixed results, with strong revenue gains at Bally's but widening losses at Caesars. Publishers show divergent performance, Pearson expanding while Scholastic misses targets. Education players are investing in AI and quantum projects, yet some institutions cut staff.

industries.summary: Disney and WBD reported revenue growth and cost‑cutting programs. Versant added digital channels and expanded streaming. Private players showed neutral signals.

themes.title: Cost cutting
themes.detail: Both Disney and WBD announced multi‑billion dollar savings plans and office consolidations.

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Executives highlighted AI use in parks and future tech initiatives.

industries.it_note: IT spend is tightening for the majors but expanding for Versant and Cox.

industries.summary: Bally's posted strong revenue growth, while Caesars recorded a larger loss. Light & Wonder and Brightstar kept margins stable but face revenue declines.

themes.title: Digital platform rebuild
themes.detail: Investments in iGaming and lottery tech are driving modest digital revenue growth.

themes.title: Selective AI use
themes.detail: AI seen as augmenting, not replacing, face‑to‑face interactions.

industries.it_note: Bally's expands IT for automation; Caesars tightens spend despite digital growth.

industries.summary: Pearson accelerated revenue and cut guidance, Wolters Kluwer expanded AI tools, while Scholastic missed revenue and widened losses.

themes.title: AI expansion
themes.detail: Libra AI rollout and AI‑powered learning platforms are being added across regions.

themes.title: Digital platform upgrades
themes.detail: Pearson launched a new Studio suite linking learning and credentials.

industries.it_note: Publishers are increasing AI and digital platform spend to drive growth.
